name: B10-0156/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming European Research Area (ERA) Act
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It asks the European Commission to propose a new law, called the European Research Area Act, to make research work better across Europe. It wants this law to be a regulation, which applies directly in every member state. It also asks for rules to protect scientific freedom, a target to spend 3% of the EU's GDP on research by 2030, and easier movement for researchers between countries.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for a future law on cross-border research.
- **Who it affects:** Researchers, universities, companies and member states' research funding.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose the law.
